item.text: The failures cluster around three general defects: computed index paths are evaluated against the wrong object, function names are not exposed to path analysis for assignment, and function definitions lose lexical visibility when later definitions shadow earlier ones. I’m correcting those shared mechanisms, plus the deep-merge and large-number arithmetic edge cases.
